english: Sky, great shining father, listen! You who split the vault, you we praise. You who set the stars, you we sing. You who freed the waters, to you we pray. Your great fame has reached the gods. We trust you, and we do not fear death. Look upon our works from above. May our bulls and sheep become strong. May our warriors be swift. May the wolf not come to our fences. Allotter, we give you this song. Hear it and receive it.

english: Dawn, shining daughter of Sky, grow bright! You who drove away the darkness, you we sing. Night, your sister, went away with the stars. You came to us on a swift chariot. You wear radiance and splendor. You walk through the middle of the space of light. You clothe the branches in brightness. The east and the sea are red. The bulls wake up and look at you. Dawn, bring us wealth. Do not hide your brightness from us. May you shine for us and our brothers. Dawn, we sing of you in our hearts.

english: Seven Waters, sisters, listen to us. You go along seven paths to the sea. The salty sea receives you. Cattle and dogs drink you. Fire is born from you. Fire dwells in your waters. You are the mothers of famous Fire. The serpent swallowed you, and the earth became thirsty. The Slayer split the serpent; you came forth again into the radiance. Sisters, go to our fields. Nourish the seed and the roots. May this year's grain become full.

pie: h₁éḱwōs tu wewkond: "ḱludʰí, h₂owey! tód spéḱyomes, n̥sméy agʰnutór ḱḗr: dʰǵʰémō, pótis, sē h₂áwyes h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ gʷʰérmom wéstrom wept, h₂áwibʰyos tu h₂wl̥h₁náh₂ né h₁esti.
english: The horses said: "Listen, sheep, our hearts pain us when we see this: a man, the master, makes the wool of the sheep into a warm garment for himself. And the sheep has no wool."

english: Earth, mother of the gods, we praise you. Sky is above, and you are below. He gives radiance; you give seed. Our fathers died, and you received them. Now they lie inside, in sleep. You hide them from the sun and the wind. You guard their long sleep of death. Remember them, Earth, and remember us. Give us offspring and wool. May our wealth and our offspring increase. May our name be famous among the warriors. Broad one, we give you gifts.

pie: owis eḱwōs kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

english: Dawn, daughter of Sky, we sing of you. Night is your sister; she clothes the earth. When you come with radiance, she leaves. You light the earth up with splendor. She follows you, and you follow her. You found the hidden cattle in the darkness. You drove them out and led them to the fields. Then the gods were astonished, and they became joyful. Dawn, now we pray to you. Lead us and our brothers to the light. Guard our fences from the wolf. May your brightness not go away from us.

pie: dyéw deywṓm ph₂tér twé h₁érkʷomes. ḱlutóm toy h₁nómn̥ gʷéHyomes. túH septḿ̥ h₂stérn̥s h₂ḱméni dʰéh₁s. túH sóh₂wl̥ tósyo h₁iméni dʰéh₁s. túH sh₂wéney ḱwoytóm déh₃s. nu kʷséps lelóykʷe h₂éwsōs toy dʰugh₂tḗr gʷémt. lewkóm nos bʰéh₂os wédʰeti. h₂stéres n̥ḱént Hyudʰsmṓs-kʷe bʰudʰént. h₂lékse nos h₁éḱwons h₂ówins-kʷe. wĺ̥kʷos tóns h₂éǵroybʰos mē h₁pyéh₁t. h₁áydʰi nos h₁wésu ḱléwos. sóh₂wl̥ widóyh₁me ǵónh₁os nos gʷíh₃woyh₁t.
english: Sky, father of the gods, we praise you. We sing your famous name. You set the seven stars on the vault. You set the sun on its course. You gave light to the sun. Now the night is gone; Dawn, your daughter, has arrived. She brings us bright radiance. The stars vanish, and the warriors wake up. Guard our horses and sheep. May the wolf not seize them from the fields. Give us good fame. May we see the sun; may our offspring live.

pie: HHḱéwih₂es h₂ékʷeh₂es usmé gʷḗm. léypos moy ḱérdi h₁ésti. bʰoydʰéh₂m Hrunépm̥ deywóh₁ tód kʷḱént. nu tóybʰos bʰebʰóyh₂h₂e. wéǵʰete h₂ékʷeh₂es léypos méd h₂epó. woséyete me wos wédn̥h₁. wédn̥su wos bʰosós sth₂éh₁yoh₂. sélpos wos wéyh₁onm̥-kʷe dédeh₃mi. diwés dʰugh₂téres téh₂ h₁áydʰwe. deywṓs moy léypos mē widóyh₁ent. ménos moy léypesos h₁léwdʰerom h₁syéh₁t. usmé h₁érkʷōh₂ h₃épōs-kʷe wos gʷéHyōh₂.
english: Swift Waters, I have come to you. There is a stain on my heart. I broke an oath; the gods caught sight of it. Now I am afraid of them. Waters, carry the stain away from me. Clothe me with your water. I stand bare in your waters. I give you butter and wine. Receive them, daughters of Sky. May the gods not see my stain. May my mind be free from the stain. I shall praise you, and I shall sing of your works.

pie: h₂éwsos diwés dʰúgh₂ter kúdʰe h₁ési? kʷséps nos dl̥h₁gʰéh₂ gʷr̥h₂éwih₂-kʷe h₁ésti. h₁widʰéwh₂es deduyḗr ḱwónes deduyḗr. ḱwoytóm toy ǵʰleymóm-kʷe wéydsomes. h₁régʷos sóh₂wl̥ h₂stérn̥s-kʷe gʷr̥h₃ét. bʰéyds toy tód dyuménh₁ lukéh₁-kʷe. nu sóh₂wl̥ tósmōd mélh₃t. nu h₂éwsos h₂éwsteroy h₁nédʰs. bʰéh₂os toy h₂éǵroysu upér tn̥néwsi. h₂éwsos n̥smé h₂ew gʷm̥dʰí n̥sméd mē léyts. wéy toy stéwtores kéh₂nmn̥ kh₂nómes. h₂éwsos toy ḱléwos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti.
english: Where are you, Dawn, daughter of Sky? The night is long and heavy for us. The widows are afraid; the dogs are afraid. We want to see your light and brightness. The darkness swallowed the sun and the stars. You split it with your splendor and light. Then the sun came forth from it. Now you have come forth in the east, Dawn. You stretch your radiance over the fields. Come to us again, Dawn; do not go away from us. We praisers sing you a song. Your fame, Dawn, is imperishable.

pie: dyéw ph₂tér upér stonh₂éyesi. gʰrómos toy méǵh₂s gʷréh₂us-kʷe h₁ésti. dʰéǵʰōm trémti móri-kʷe trémti. gʷówes h₂éǵroysu bʰebʰih₂ḗr. h₂énh₁mos toy móri Hyowdʰéyeti. sérpontih₂ h₁ógʷʰis wódr̥h₂ ḱélet. gʷʰéns h₁ógʷʰim gʰrómoh₁ spérs-kʷe n̥sméy wódr̥h₂. nu wódr̥h₂ dʰéǵʰōm ní yéh₂ti. gʷʰéntor twé kh₂nómes twé-kʷe h₁érkʷomes. Hyudʰsmóns nos kóryoy mē gʷʰéns. stérge nos h₂éǵrons gʰórdʰons-kʷe. ḱléwos toy ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁syéh₁t.
english: Father Sky, you thunder from above. Your thunder is great and heavy. The earth trembles, and the sea trembles. The cattle are afraid in the fields. Your wind stirs up the sea. The crawling serpent was hiding the waters. You slew the serpent with thunder and freed the waters for us. Now the waters go down to the earth. Slayer, we sing of you and praise you. Do not strike down our warriors in the war. Protect our fields and fences. May your fame be imperishable.

english: Mother Earth, you stand beneath the sky. You do not tremble at the heavy thunder. Beavers live in your waters. Your grain nourishes us. We stand on your navel. There we light the fire. There we speak good words. The waters clothed you; the gods lifted you up. They set a famous name on you, and you rejoiced. You became broad and great. May you stand for us and our offspring. Give us wealth and imperishable fame.

pie: sóh₂wl̥ mr̥twóns ǵʰémi Hn̥dʰí h₁éysi. mr̥twṓs swépnoy h₂én ḱéyn̥tor. túH tóns deywóysu h₁óynos dedórḱth₂e. dl̥h₁gʰóm tóysōm swépnom lowkéyesi. nu h₂éwsterōy wédn̥bʰos h₁nédʰs. h₂éwsosm̥ tósyeh₂s h₁iméni sékʷeth₂er. léwks toy h₂éǵrons h₂eh₂nóḱe. bʰébʰrewes wédn̥su sn̥h₂énti. kʷékʷlos toy wéndʰetor só-kʷe ne Hrumptór. sóh₂wl̥ nos séh₁mn̥ mē h₁éwses. h₂éḱōs nos gʷréh₂uh₂ h₁wésuh₂-kʷe h₁syéh₁t. duh₃dʰí mr̥twóybʰos léwkm̥.
english: Sun, you go under the earth to the dead. There the dead are lying in sleep. You alone of the gods see them. You light up their long sleep. Then you come forth from the eastern waters. You follow Dawn on her course. Your light has reached the fields. The beavers swim in the waters. Your wheel turns, and it does not break. Sun, do not burn our seed. May our ears of grain be heavy and good. Give light to the dead.

pie: h₂éwsos h₁régʷesi bʰéwdʰm̥. dʰh₁sbʰós péh₂wr̥ lowkéyom. sélpos wéyh₁onm̥-kʷe h₂réydʰom. nu twé kh₂nóh₂ twé-kʷe moldʰéyoh₂. h₁n̥dʰdʰí léwkeh₂ diwés dʰúgh₂ter. lowkéye moy stóygʰons gʰórdʰons-kʷe. wédʰe moy ḱr̥déy ǵʰleymóm. h₂éǵe moy wĺ̥kʷom h₂éwibʰos h₂epó. h₁áydʰi moy péḱos téwh₂os-kʷe. tód toy kéh₂nmn̥ h₁opéyoh₂. h₁eǵ moy te bʰréh₂tēr-kʷe kʷḱyéh₁m̥. h₂éwsos me mē linékʷs h₂ew gʷm̥yé.
english: Dawn, I woke up in the darkness. I lit the fire for the gods. I prepared the butter and the wine. Now I sing of you, and I pray to you. Come forth, shining daughter of Sky. Light up my paths and my fences. Bring brightness to my heart. Drive the wolf away from my sheep. Give me wealth and might. I give you this song. May I and my brother catch sight of you. Do not leave me, Dawn; come again.

english: Father Sky, hear our words. Giver of good things, we sing of you. You hold up the broad space of light. You are great among the gods. With heavy thunder you split the vault. Then the waters came forth from it. The broad earth drank the water. You look upon us from above. You know the long paths of the stars. Our hearts and minds are turned towards you. The dogs are afraid of your thunder. Give us swift horses. Guard our sheep from the wolf. May our fame be imperishable. Shining one, listen to our song.

english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

english: Fire, carrier of songs, listen to us. The praisers sing of you. Fire, you know the long ways. Carry our song to Sky, the allotter. Carry our butter to Dawn. Carry our grain to the Sun. May the gods be sated with our gifts. You went to the gods and brought their word to us. Your fire shines for the gods. Give us imperishable fame. May we live in your radiance. Fire, we sing your famous name.

pie: h₁ń̥gʷni toy sélpos bʰéroh₂. tód toy moy ǵʰóstōys h₂réydʰom. ǵr̥h₂nóm toy dédeh₃mi kéh₂nmn̥ toy gʷéHyoh₂. h₁ń̥gʷni téh₂ h₁áyso bʰére-kʷe deywóybʰos téh₂. h₂óytōm nos wéǵʰtōr h₁ési. gʷṓs toy péḱos-kʷe gʷʰodʰéyoh₂. ǵónh₁om ḱléwos-kʷe gʷʰodʰéyoh₂. h₁ń̥gʷni moy tóns h₂m̥bʰí dh₃dʰí. ph₂sdʰí me wĺ̥kʷōd tórgʷōd-kʷe. h₁ń̥gʷni moy h₁mé bʰréh₂term̥-kʷe mē h₁éwses. stéwtōr toy h₁ésmi túH-kʷe moy dʰéh₁s h₁ési. h₂éwsosm̥ sóh₂wl̥-kʷe h₂ew kʷḱyéh₁m̥.
english: Fire, I bring you butter. I prepared it for you with my hands. I give you grain; I sing you a song. Receive them, Fire, and carry them to the gods. You are the carrier of our gifts. I ask you for cattle and wealth. I ask for offspring and fame. Give them to me, Fire, in exchange. Guard me from the wolf and from fear. Fire, do not burn me and my brother. I am your praiser, and you are my god. May I catch sight of the dawn and the sun again.

pie: h₁wŕ̥Hewih₂ dʰéǵʰom méh₂ter twé gʷéHyomes. gʷṓs h₁éḱwons-kʷe bʰéresi. wódr̥h₂ móri-kʷe bʰéresi. wréh₂dn̥s séh₁mn̥h₂-kʷe bʰéresi. h₃nóbʰōl toy médʰyoy ḱéytor. mr̥twṓs h₂én ḱóm ḱéyn̥tor. kʷís te toy h₁wŕ̥Hewih₂ h₂éǵrons-kʷe tḗtḱt? deywṓs te ǵʰóstōys tétḱn̥t. dʰéǵʰom dʰedʰówgʰth₂e h₂élesi-kʷe nos. dyḗws toy séh₁mn̥ déh₃t ǵr̥h₂nóm twéd h₂wékst. h₂éle nos táwrons h₂éḱōs nos h₂uksyéh₁t. h₁yód nos h₂énh₁mos léyteti h₁áyso nos.
english: Broad Mother Earth, we sing of you. You carry the cattle and the horses. You carry the waters and the sea. You carry the roots and the seeds. Your navel lies in the middle. There the dead lie side by side. Who created you and your fields, broad one? The gods created you with their hands. Earth, you are productive, and you nourish us. Sky gave you seed, and grain grew from you. Nourish our bulls, and may our ears of grain grow. When our spirit goes away, receive us.

pie: sóh₂wl̥ h₁éymn̥h₂ wóydth₂e túH ne h₃sléydʰs. bʰréh₂term̥ moy dl̥h₁gʰóy stóygʰoy h₁éymi. h₁ógʷʰeyes tr̥néh₂-kʷe tósmi h₁sénti. h₁idʰí pró lowkéye moy tóm. h₂lékse moy toy gʷéh₂mn̥h₂ ǵʰleymóh₁. sóh₂wl̥ tósmōd mē h₃slidʰyéh₁m̥. wĺ̥kʷōs me ḱwónes-kʷe mē kʷḱih₁ént. h₂én h₁ludʰóyh₁m̥ só-kʷe me widóyh₁t. méh₂tēr moy twé moldʰéyeti. swésōr moy ph₂wéni sísdeti. tā́s péḱesh₁ h₂ew gʷm̥yéh₁m̥. sóh₂wl̥ toy wéyh₁onm̥ déh₃woh₂.
english: Sun, you know the ways; you do not go astray. I go on a long path to my brother. On it there are serpents and thorns. Go on ahead; light it up for me. Guard my steps with your brightness. May I not go astray from it, Sun. May the wolves and the dogs not catch sight of me. May I arrive there, and may he see me. My mother is praying to you. My sister is sitting by the fire. May I come back to them again with wealth. Sun, I shall give you wine.

pie: deywṓs h₁uséwōm déh₃tores n̥smé gʷm̥té. médʰyoy sdté wéyh₁onm̥-kʷe ph₃té. dʰéh₁ses wos ḱr̥dsú mudté. dyéw toy ph₂tér h₂uséh₁ dʰugh₂tréh₁ gʷm̥yé. h₁ń̥gʷni sóh₂wl̥ h₂ékʷās-kʷe wédʰe. dʰéǵʰom nos méh₂ter ḱl̥nudʰí. gʷʰn̥té deywṓs h₁ógʷʰim gʰrómoh₁. wódr̥h₂ gʷṓs-kʷe h₂ḱnés spr̥té. sóh₂wl̥ h₂stérn̥s-kʷe upér dʰh₁té. nu wos méǵh₂ ḱléwos gʷéHyomes. h₁áyte nos gʷeyóm téwh₂os-kʷe. h₂léksete nos wĺ̥kʷōd h₁élḱesbʰos-kʷe. téwh₂os wos ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁ésti.
english: Gods, givers of good things, come to us! Sit down in the middle and drink the wine. Become joyful, gods, in your hearts. Father Sky, come with your daughter Dawn. Fire, bring the Sun and the Waters. Mother Earth, listen to us. Gods, you slew the serpent with thunder. You freed the waters and the cattle from the stone. You set the sun and the stars above. Now we sing your great fame. Give us victory and might. Protect us from the wolf and from sores. Your might is imperishable.

pie: h₂éwsos gʷéms h₁régʷos lelóykʷe. h₂éwsos nos ḱwoytós h₁ési. h₂réwesi mréy wédn̥su-kʷe. h₂réwesi wr̥h₂dsú uh₁itéysu-kʷe. h₂réwesi dʰh₁sú mr̥twóysu-kʷe. h₂réwe nos h₂éwsos h₂réwe nos bʰréh₂tr̥bʰos. h₁yód úd léh₂ps deywṓs mudént kéh₂nmn̥ toy gʷéHyont. nu toy tód kéh₂nmn̥ h₂ew kh₂nómes. diwés nos dʰúgh₂ter wékʷōs h₁áyso. duh₃dʰí nos gʷeyóm ḱléwos-kʷe. tórgʷōd h₁léwdʰerōs h₁sih₁mé. léwkeh₂ nos twé ḱr̥dsú h₁érkʷomes.
english: Dawn, you have come; the darkness is gone. Dawn, you are our light. You shine on the sea and the waters. You shine on the roots and the branches. You shine on the gods and on the dead. Shine for us, Dawn; shine for our brothers. When you flashed up, the gods became joyful; they sang a song to you. Now we sing that song to you again. Daughter of Sky, receive our words. Give us victory and fame. May we be free from fear. Shining one, we praise you in our hearts.

english: Mother Earth, your fields are broad. Your sheep give wool. Your bulls are swift and heavy. We milk your cattle; we eat your grain. We drink your water, and our hearts become joyful. What do we give you in exchange? In exchange we give you songs and butter. Sky saw you, and he came to love you. The gods are born from you and from Sky. The gods stand on your navel. Protect our offspring and our sheep. Earth, hear our words.

pie: h₂éwsos n̥smé bʰéh₂esh₁ gʷm̥yé. túH dl̥h₁gʰóns stóygʰons lowkéyonti. túH h₁wr̥Héwih₂m̥ dʰéǵʰōm lowkéyesi. túH móri lowkéyesi. kʷséps tébʰye h₂éḱmonm̥ tyogʷéyeti. dyḗws toy ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ déh₃t. h₂éwsos toy twé h₁iméni dʰéh₁t. h₂ew gʷm̥sḱési ḱwónes-kʷe bʰudʰént. Hyudʰsmṓs kʷékʷlons yungénti. h₂éwsos nos péḱos h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m-kʷe duh₃dʰí. léwkm̥ toy dyéwmn̥-kʷe h₂ew kʷḱih₁mé. h₂éwsos nos h₁régʷesi mē linékʷs.
english: Dawn, come to us with radiance. You light up the long paths. You light up the broad earth. You light up the sea. Night gives up the vault to you. Sky gave you a famous name. He set you on your course, Dawn. You come again, and the dogs wake up. The warriors yoke their chariots. Dawn, give us wealth and wool. May we catch sight of your light and splendor again. Do not leave us in the darkness, Dawn.

pie: diwés deywṓs usmé h₁érkʷomes. méǵh₂s wos dyḗws ph₂tḗr h₁ésti. dʰéǵʰōm wos méh₂tēr h₁ésti. h₂éwsōs wos swésōr h₁ésti. h₁n̥gʷnís nos usméy h₂óytons wéǵʰeti. sóh₂wl̥ nos h₃épōs dedórḱe. h₁régʷos wédn̥su ḱéyto. tód lukéh₁ bʰéh₂esh₁-kʷe bʰidté. h₂éwsōs h₁nédʰt sóh₂wl̥-kʷe léwkt. nu gʷówes gʷíh₃wonti wódr̥h₂-kʷe gʷíh₃weti. dʰéh₁ses nos mē tyogʷéyete. h₁opéyete nos dyéwmn̥ péḱos-kʷe.
english: Gods of Sky, we praise you. Great Sky is your father. Earth is your mother. Dawn is your sister. Fire carries our gifts to you. The Sun sees our works. Darkness lay on the waters. You split it with light and radiance. Dawn came forth, and the Sun became bright. Now the cattle live, and the waters live. Gods, do not give us up. Give us splendor and wealth.

english: Who are you, bright and swift ones? We are the Waters, the daughters of Sky. Where do you go on your courses? We go down to the salty sea. What do you carry in your waters? We carry the stains away. What do you give to the roots, sisters? We give water to the roots. Daughters of Sky, we pray to you. Carry our stains away. Nourish our offspring and our swift horses. May you not dry up for us, sisters.

pie: h₁ń̥gʷni h₁uséwōm déh₃tor twé kh₂nómes. wédn̥bʰos ǵeǵónh₁th₂e. deywóybʰos nos h₂óytons wéǵʰesi. h₁ń̥gʷni dʰh₁sbʰós n̥sméy bʰéh₂si. sélpos léyǵʰsi péh₂wr̥-kʷe toy dʰégʷʰeti. uh₁itéysu ḱéleth₂e. deywṓs te h₂isḱónt twé-kʷe kʷḱént. twé h₁éǵʰs wédʰont twé-kʷe médʰyoy sodéyont. wéǵʰe h₁ń̥gʷni tóns n̥smé. tóy sdih₁ént wéyh₁onm̥-kʷe ph₃ih₁ént. h₁ń̥gʷni nos swépnom gʰórdʰons-kʷe ph₂sdʰí. HéHḱu nos h₁ń̥gʷni mē h₁éwses.
english: Fire, giver of good things, we sing of you. You are born from the waters. You carry our gifts to the gods. Fire, you speak to the gods for us. You lick the butter, and your fire burns. You hid yourself in the branches. The gods sought you and caught sight of you. They led you out, and they seated you in the middle. Bring them to us, Fire. May they sit down and drink the wine. Fire, guard our sleep and our fences. Do not burn us, swift Fire.

pie: deywṓs wos Hyudʰsmós h₁ésmi. kóryom moy bʰréh₂tr̥bʰis h₁éymi. dwóh₁ moy h₁éḱwoh₁ kʷékʷlom wéǵʰetes. ḱḗr moy ménos-kʷe ne tréseti. ph₂sté me dʰéh₁ses kóryoy. h₂én mē mr̥yéh₁m̥ h₂én mē sn̥gʷyéh₁m̥. Hyudʰsmóns moy téwh₂esh₁ tr̥h₂uyéh₁m̥. wĺ̥kʷōs ḱwónes-kʷe mr̥twóns h₁dih₁ént. h₁ógʷʰim tr̥h₂uté dyḗws ph₂tḗr tā́m gʰrómoh₁ gʷʰént. dh₃té moy gʷeyóm kóryoy. h₁yód h₂ew gʷémoh₂ septḿ̥ wos gʷṓs déh₃woh₂. ḱléwos moy ń̥dʰgʷʰitom h₁syéh₁t.
english: Gods, I am your warrior. I go to war with my brothers. Two horses carry my chariot. My heart and my mind do not tremble in fear. Protect me in the war, gods. May I not die there; may I not fall there. May I overcome the warriors with my might. May the wolves and the dogs eat the dead. You overcame the serpent; Father Sky struck it down with thunder. Give me victory in the war. If I come back, I shall give you seven cattle. May my fame be imperishable.
